C1.worst_defect: The hero says what it is and offers 'Live demo' and 'Quick start', but nowhere on home is there a who-this-is-not-for line next to Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed (no integrated card terminal, no cash drawer, desktop Chrome only, Postgres only). Those deal-breakers are scattered through the 'Before you start' bullets at the bottom of the page instead.

C2.worst_defect: 'MIT licensed' is the footer headline, but 'Before you start' says self-hosting the till needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)' and never says that is a paid, proprietary licence or what it costs. Nothing says who runs app.vendurepos.com, on what terms or for how long. The only operator hint is an unexplained third-party domain, 'ph.wcpos.com'.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' bullet 6 and the demo table's last row; connect-a-till.desktop.01 'Where requests go'

C3.worst_defect: The device-key path ships with a known gap. The plugin's own 'New POS till key' creates the vendurepos-pos-till role 'except ReadOrder', so after following the steps the till's order history is refused until you edit the role by hand. Step 4 also asks for a role with five named permissions plus ReadOrder but gives no Dashboard steps to create it on the quick-start page.
C3.where: quick-start text 'Optional: a device key for each till' and step 4 (quick-start.desktop.02)

C4.worst_defect: The Changelog covers only '@vendurepos/plugin'. The till at app.vendurepos.com, which is what a store actually runs and which changes under you, has no version or change history anywhere on the site. The plugin changelog also carries an editorial patch, 'Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder', which documents a bug instead of a fix six weeks after the last release (2026-10-06).
C4.where: changelog.desktop.01 ('Released versions of the @vendurepos/plugin package'; 0.2.0 last bullet)

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' is ten identical grey text cards with no icon, figure or screenshot. Home has just one product image, so the till's payment, cashier sheet and Z-report screens, which appear in At the till, never back up the claims where buyers read them. The og-image also crops the cart mid-button ('Add charge' cut off at the bottom edge).
C5.where: home.desktop.01-02 feature grid; og-image.png bottom edge

C6.worst_defect: On a phone, code blocks hard-wrap instead of scrolling. For example 'taxLineCalculationStrategy: new' / 'DefaultTaxLineCalculationStrategy(),' and the import line split across indented lines, which makes config hard to read and compare on a 390 px screen.
C6.where: quick-start.phone.06 tax options block; quick-start.phone.02 import block

C7.worst_defect: The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD on home has no softwareVersion, although the page badge says 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0'. The search API's breadcrumbs are only ['VendurePOS'], so results do not show which docs section they come from. Otherwise strong: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, real 404 status, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, sitemap with lastmod.

overall_worst.defect: The site sells 'MIT licensed' and 'open-source' but leaves a client with two undisclosed dependencies. One is a hosted till at app.vendurepos.com with no named operator, terms or support statement. The other is self-hosting that needs an 'RxDB Premium licence token', never said to be a paid proprietary licence. A sceptic advising a shop cannot tell what it will cost or who they depend on.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' (bullet 'The till's source is MIT licensed...'); connect-a-till.desktop.01; limitations 'Setting up the store'
overall_worst.fix: Add one plain line on home and in Limitations: 'RxDB Premium is a paid commercial licence from RxDB (link to its pricing); app.vendurepos.com is run free by <named maintainer/company> with no SLA.'
